Quadrant Health

## The AI Workforce for Healthcare.

Proactive voice and agentic AI that absorbs the administrative work, lifts outcomes, and raises satisfaction across every patient touchpoint.

The Problem

## Healthcare has an execution shortage.

Roughly 30% of every U.S. healthcare dollar goes to administrative work that still leaves patient calls unanswered, care gaps open, and follow-ups quietly slipping past their window. Quadrant is the layer that finishes the work.

![Image 1: Completed patient chart](https://quadrant.health/assets/Asset5.svg)

Results

83%

patient engagement on AI-led outreach campaigns

70%+

of patient calls handled without staff involvement

2M+

patient interactions annually

Customers

Trusted by medical groups and health systems across the country.

Customer Outcomes

## What completed work looks like.

Worked with leading organizations

![Image 2: Stanford Health Care](https://quadrant.health/customer-logos/stanford-health-care.svg)

![Image 3: Mayo Clinic Platform](https://quadrant.health/customer-logos/mayo-clinic-platform.webp)

Featured Partnership · EHR

### Quadrant × medent®

![Image 4: Medent logo](https://quadrant.health/logos/medent.png)

Medent is a Quadrant EHR partner. Our voice and agentic AI agents run natively inside Medent, giving every Medent practice a path to 24/7 front-desk coverage, automated care-gap closure, and complete visit workflows.

For four decades Medent has served independent practices with EHR software they trust. Quadrant adds the AI workforce piece. Voice, agents, and chart updates, built into Medent as a first-party extension of the clinical surface.

24/7 Front-desk coverage

<2 wk Onboarding

The Platform

## First ring. Chart updated.Everything in between.

Voice and text get the patient on the line. Agentic AI completes the work inside your systems. Every action logged, every outcome tracked.

### Every call answered. Every action completed.

Quadrant picks up on the first ring. 24/7, in 20+ languages, via voice and bi-directional text. Handles the conversation, then operates your EHR to finish the job. Staff only see the calls that actually need them.

Scheduling & Reschedules

Books, reschedules, and cancels appointments across providers, locations, and visit types. Configurable rules, buffers, and insurance mapping.

Patient Intake

Collects demographics, insurance, and clinical information before the visit. Writes it to the chart so the patient arrives ready.

Medication Refills

Takes refill requests, checks controlled substance logic, and routes to the provider with the right context. No phone tag.

Insurance Verification

Captures insurance details, walks patients through finding card info, and logs it to the chart.

### Proactive outreach that closes gaps and fills chairs.

Define the goal. Set the sequence. Quadrant runs calls and texts until the success criteria are met. Configurable retry logic, time-zone-aware delivery, TCPA-compliant opt-out.

Care Gap Closure

AWV reminders, mammograms, colorectal screenings, diabetic eye exams, HbA1c, blood pressure management. Calls the patient, books the appointment, logs it to the EHR.

Appointment Reminders & Confirmations

Confirms upcoming visits, reschedules on the spot, and backfills cancellations.

No-Show Recovery

Calls back within minutes of a missed appointment, reschedules, and updates the chart.

Pre-Op & Post-Op Check-Ins

Runs pre-surgical checklists and post-op recovery surveys. Escalates issues in real time.

### The work before, during, and after the visit.

Quadrant doesn't stop at the phone. AI scribe captures encounters live. Care management agents keep chronic patients engaged between visits and support billable CCM programs.

Ambient Scribe

Captures encounters in real time, drafts SOAP and procedure notes, and writes back to Epic

For over 65 years, we've delivered practical, innovative and sustainable solutions that make a positive impact on communities across the UK and Ireland. As a Graduate Transport Planner, you'll work alongside experienced planners, engineers and consultants, contributing to a wide range of projects while developing the technical and professional skills you need to build your career. Whether you're interested in transport assessments, active travel & sustainable mobility, highways or public transport, we'll give you the experience, guidance and support to find the areas that interest you most and develop your expertise in development planning. What you'll be doing You will support the planning and development process, helping clients bring projects forward from initial concept through to planning approval. Your responsibilities will include: Assisting with the preparation of Transport Assessments and Transport Statements. Supporting the production of Travel Plans and technical planning reports. Supporting planning applications for residential, commercial and mixed-use developments. Working alongside planners, civil engineers and other specialists to deliver integrated solutions. Attending client meetings, project discussions and stakeholder consultations. Taking part in wider Curtins activities including STEM outreach, charity initiatives and community projects. What kind of projects will I get to work on? You'll be involved in projects across a wide range of sectors, including: Residential developments. Urban regeneration schemes.
